public.text: “Actor” is defined as an abstract information-processing role, while other parts of the document use actor to include people, organisations, and stakeholders. The same term therefore has different meanings.
public.suggestedRevision: Use application actor role or IHE actor role in this subsection, and distinguish it explicitly from human actors, organisational actors, and stakeholder elements.
